name: Intimation Letter
body:
Date: 2026-07-03

To,
{{borrower_name}}
Address: {{address}}

Subject: Intimation of Loan Outstanding Amount for Loan No: {{loan_no}}

Dear {{borrower_name}},

This is to intimate you that your loan account {{loan_no}} has an outstanding amount of INR {{outstanding_amount}} which is due on {{due_date}}.

Please ensure that the payment is cleared by the due date to avoid any late payment charges.

If you have already paid this amount, please ignore this notice.

Sincerely,
Notice Management Department

name: Demand Notice
body:
Date: 2026-07-03

To,
{{borrower_name}}
Address: {{address}}

Subject: DEMAND NOTICE - IMMEDIATE PAYMENT REQUIRED FOR LOAN NO: {{loan_no}}

Dear {{borrower_name}},

Despite previous intimations, your loan account {{loan_no}} has an overdue outstanding amount of INR {{outstanding_amount}} which was due on {{due_date}}.

You are hereby requested to clear this outstanding amount of INR {{outstanding_amount}} immediately. Failure to do so within 7 days from the receipt of this notice will compel us to initiate legal proceedings under applicable laws.

Please contact our collection team immediately.

Sincerely,
Legal and Collections Division
